gloss: work arrangement; employment format; work style

definitions.gloss: work arrangement; employment format; working pattern
definitions.explanation: The type or style of employment, including factors such as full-time vs. part-time, shift schedules, remote work, and contract type.

examples.japanese: {勤務形態|きんむけいたい}は{正社員|せいしゃいん}です。
examples.english: My work arrangement is full-time employment.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{柔軟|じゅうなん}な{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: The company introduced flexible work arrangements.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}をきっかけに、テレワークという{新|あたら}しい{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}が{一般的|いっぱんてき}になった。
examples.english: The pandemic led to remote work becoming a common new work arrangement.

notes:
A formal business term composed of {勤務|きんむ} (work, service) + {形態|けいたい} (form, format). Used extensively in HR contexts, job listings, and workplace policy discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勤務形態|きんむけいたい}を{変|か}える: to change one's work arrangement
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}な{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}: flexible work arrangements
- {多様|たよう}な{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}: diverse work styles
- {勤務形態|きんむけいたい}の{選択肢|せんたくし}: work arrangement options

TYPES OF WORK ARRANGEMENTS:
- {正社員|せいしゃいん}: full-time permanent employee
- パート / アルバイト: part-time work
- {派遣|はけん}: temporary/dispatched work
- {契約社員|けいやくしゃいん}: contract employee
- フレックスタイム: flextime
- テレワーク / {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}: remote work
- {時短勤務|じたんきんむ}: shortened work hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {働|はたら}き{方|かた}: way of working — more casual and broader, covers work-life balance philosophy as well as employment type
- {雇用形態|こようけいたい}: employment type — very similar but focuses specifically on the contractual relationship between employer and employee
